page.layout: One printed page, title page, centred lines throughout; handwriting at top left and a letter mark at left edge are not printed text. No margin notes.
page.notes: Handwritten inscription at top left ("Collegij Soc. Iesu Monasterij") and a handwritten date and name ("Sum Ioh. Georgij à Werdenstein 1565") are manuscript, not transcribed as printed text. The Greek "οπισοχραφια" is transcribed as printed (likely ὀπισθόγραφα); the "1565" line is handwritten, while the printed imprint reads M. D. LXIIII. The left-edge mark "R" is handwriting. Some letters in the imprint line are doubtful.
